methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Growth → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.2x) to $50M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Orbital Marine Power is a Growth-stage company operating in Ocean & Maritime technology. The company has raised $50M+ to date. The comparable universe is limited: no public peers are available for benchmarking, and only one material private comparable—Ocean Infinity—provides a reference point for the sector.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, the sole applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. Using total capital raised ($50M) as a proxy for recent valuation, a standard Growth-stage step-up multiplier of 1.2x yields an implied valuation of $60M. This reflects typical value creation between financing rounds at this stage, absent revenue or profitability benchmarks.

The triangulated range spans $51M (low) to $69M (high), with $60M as the median. The narrow methodological base—one applicable technique across a sector with sparse comparable data—introduces material uncertainty. No public market precedent exists for Ocean & Maritime technology at this scale, and reliance on a single private peer limits cross-validation. Key variables affecting valuation within this range include technology commercialization progress, customer pipeline depth, and burn trajectory. Absent current-year revenue or unit economics, stage-progression serves as a conservative floor rather than a definitive valuation anchor.
